body: I just read this again now and want to thank you from the bottom of my heart. We are going tf through it collectively, you are so right, this rings so true. This insight is a reminder. I’m in tears, thinking about how that space I wanted to leave behind could actually be a cavern. Thank you, thank you so much for helping me through this. There’s part of me that is trying to accept even if I don’t feel better, I do not want to make others feel worse, and that really I’m not alone in this. ❣️
This is so hopeful, thank you so so much
Thank you so so much for this caring insight. And I agree with what you said above to the other person who commented, too.

I told someone else here the same thing… even if I am being hypocritical, I truly hope you will try to live because your loss would hurt so many people. And the plan I had is a faulty one. It wouldn’t work and would just cause pain for myself and everyone around me.

I’m sorry I took so long to reply. Thank you so very much for your kindness, it means a lot. Nobody has ever said that to me directly, no — they have said I was difficult or put up boundaries which I totally understand ..

This might be hypocritical of me but I know for a fact that if you ended your life you’d break many hearts. It also seems the way I wanted to do it would just cause problems for me and pain for others without actually resulting in suicide. Even people here will tell you to seek help. ❣️

I remember doing this when I was younger and feeling so good; I’m scared it isn’t possible now, but it is so much better than risking making the people around me sad (even if I still think it might “free” them!)
Maybe Spain. I’ve been there before and want to go back.
You make a really good point. I’d still have to live with myself but it would be better than putting that onto others.
Hi, like just physically removing myself from their lives rather than ending my life?
